title: Clipping, November 15, 1909
snip: Clipping from the Bibliographical Society, December 1909 on a paper read by Osler on "The Library of Robert Burton." Attached to it, there is an extract from the Transactions of the Bibliographical Society giving the summary of Osler's lecture.
